title: PEARL Verification Result v1
description: The only accepted output shape for a Machine Verifier. Article 8: the verifier decides, not the agent. Written to stdout as machine JSON only (Section 26).

status.description: pass = verified. fail = verifier ran and rejected. error = verifier could not decide (never treated as pass).

verifier.description: Capability id of the verifier that produced this result.

checks.description: At least one check must be reported. An empty check list cannot establish verification.
